When reviewing pull requests, do not review `man/*.Rd`.

Before creating or editing code or documentation, read `AGENTS.md` and the root `STYLE.md`. `STYLE.md` is the canonical style policy and overrides generic skill examples and older code. Follow it manually while Air and lintr remain unactivated; do not install tools, run repository-wide formatting, or add style CI without a request. Preserve detailed procedural and closing-delimiter comments. Flag coordinated API selection arguments for the maintainer's confirmation as specified in `STYLE.md`.
